coder_notes: device_dependent set true under manual R4 because the registered intervention pairs MTX110 with a programmable pump and catheter system for convection-enhanced delivery; the record does not say the device is needed for the antitumour effect, so an adjudicator may prefer false. Arm 'Cohort B' is a continued-dosing/catheter-repositioning variation, not a control.
